text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Alright, got great seats! Waiting alllll 
that time was totally worth it...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! I'm crazy sleepy, but today's Japan 
Cup is legitimately legendary tier...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
After all, THE Special Week is running in 
it!

—It was right after the Queen Elizabeth II 
Cup that Special Week decided to enter the 
Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I, Special Week, will be running in the 
Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It is true that, at one point, I had fully 
intended to step away from racing.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Still, watching the current Twinkle 
Series— no, watching Cesario-san, that's 
what made me realize it!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I knew it... I can't stand just watching 
from the stands!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So, I've decided! I'm going to train up 
again, reclaim my prime racing days, and—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'll enter the Japan Cup and win again!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...It might not be that simple. I've lost 
muscle, and my instincts... who knows. 
I've been taking it easy for a while.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I really want to do this. Not just 
leave it to others, but do something 
myself."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: —Hey, Cesario-san.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Japan's Supreme Commander. Please, surpass 
me and leave my back behind.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...If it can truly be surpassed!

Special Week's entry into the Japan Cup 
and her declaration of intent shook the 
public—

The upcoming clash between Cesario and 
Special Week had drawn massive attention!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
That Japan Cup Special Week won before— To 
be honest, I still watch it from time to 
time.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
As you may know, Trainer, that year's 
Japan Cup was truly unprecedented.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Alongside the Umamusume who conquered the 
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, the 'Hero of 
Hong Kong,' the 'Star of 
Britain'—legendary Umamusume gathered one 
after another..."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
A formidable overseas lineup, the likes of 
which is rarely seen. Their level was 
truly formidable.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
In a race like that, Special Week-san 
carried the hopes of all Japan on her 
shoulders—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"She truly is Japan's Supreme Commander!! 
Special Week takes the winーーー!!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: She achieved a magnificent victory……!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
In that moment, Special Week-san had truly 
surpassed even the "world."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: That is precisely why—today, I must win.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"I must surpass that back, and bridge the 
way to the future."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...And besides.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Is this conceit on my part?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"By all means, try to surpass me. If you 
think you can, that is."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, it sounded like a farewell 
message to me.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Even in that sense, I want to win. Today, 
against her.
